description: Five links. Two deterministic, three inferred. The shared device is what connects the collector to the pass-through account, and the validity bounds are what make that connection mean something: the same device two years apart is not a relationship.

metadata_json.note: No confidence field. The identifier came from the account record itself, so this is an observation.
The same device as the collector, in an overlapping window. This single pair is what turns two accounts into a component in the graph view.
A shared IP inside one day. Weak on its own -- a carrier NAT puts thousands of unrelated people behind one address -- which is why it is inferred, scored, and waiting on a person.
The other end of the same weak link.

Rejected by a reviewer. It stays in the table rather than being deleted: the fact that somebody looked and said no is worth more than a clean table, and it stops the same inference being re-raised next week.
